product.name: 가람건강 — 보건소 예약·복약 알림 모바일 웹
product.category: public health service: vaccination and check-up booking, chronic-medication reminders

method.summary: Stage 0 per references/ergonomics/audience-research.md. Read the product brief (the only product material allowed), listed its user groups, contexts and tasks, then ran 29 web searches (2 more were rejected by the search API): Korean official statistics (국가데이터처 고령자 통계, 과기정통부·NIA 디지털정보격차 실태조사, 방통위 방송매체 이용행태조사, 보건복지부 등록장애인 현황, 질병관리청·건보 인플루엔자 연례보고서, KDCA PHWR), a phone-brand survey (한국갤럽), prevalence papers (Korean CVD, Korean essential tremor, Fujian presbyopia, Korea hypertension fact sheet), comparable services (2021 COVID-19 online pre-booking, 똑닥) and public community posts (82cook, dcinside, clien, instiz, theqoo) for contexts and pain points. The service opened on 2026-09-21, so no product analytics, tickets or interviews exist; ask 가람시 보건소 for channel logs before re-weighting.
limitations: Direct page fetches (WebFetch and curl) were blocked by the network egress proxy for every host tried (korea.kr, kmcc.go.kr, eiec.kdi.re.kr, data.go.kr, bioin.or.kr, PubMed, Wikipedia, both app stores). Every external quote is a search-result title or the search tool's extract of the page, not a first-hand read; re-check numbers against the originals before a report cites them.
The search tool's extracts can paraphrase. Verbatim headlines are used as quotes where they exist; the 2021 proxy-booking guidance was seen only in an English rendering and is labelled inference.

No product analytics, support tickets, interviews or usability tests. Only the proxy segment has a share, estimated from the health centre's phone channel as reported in the brief (41% of last season's phone bookings), not from the mobile channel.
가람시 is described only in the brief. National statistics bound segments; they are not this product's user base.
No Korean age-specific presbyopia prevalence was found. Presbyopia shares use the Fujian Eye Study (China, adults over 50, uncorrected presbyopia 68.6%) as an East-Asian proxy, low confidence.

Age-band, device-model and familiarity splits inside segments are placeholders or derivations from the brief's age ranges, Gallup brand shares and the launch date, not measurements (see each segment's notes).

Firsthand evidence is limited to community post titles (medication memory, urgent health certificates). No firsthand post about proxy vaccination booking or older adults booking from a text link was found, and app-store reviews could not be read.

Community posts are self-selected and problem-skewed: they show that a pain exists, never how common it is. Disabled users rarely post about accessibility, so absence of complaints is not absence of users.
The 2025 방송매체 이용행태조사 figure for 70+ could not be retrieved; the 2024 headline figure (73%) is used. It differs from Gallup's 91% (2025) by survey mode, population and definition (owning vs using).
29 searches were run against a target of 25 because early official-statistics queries returned no numbers; no further searches were made after that.

segments.name_ko: 점심시간·출퇴근길에 부모 접종을 대신 예약하는 40~50대 직장인 자녀
segments.summary: Adult children, mostly employed, who book, check, change or cancel a registered parent's free flu shot or check-up from a KakaoTalk alimtalk/SMS link: one-handed on a bus or subway, or at the desk at lunch after siblings agree in a group chat who books. They want it done within about five minutes and share a screenshot of the result. The costly error is the wrong parent name or birth date (on-site re-registration).

share.note: 41% of last season's PHONE bookings were proxy bookings (brief section 2). The mobile share is not measured; it is plausibly higher because the children are the more digital party (inference).

evidence.claim: About 41% of last season's phone bookings were made by someone else, and proxy bookings often carried the wrong name or birth date, forcing re-registration on site.
evidence.quote: 지난 절기 전화 예약의 약 41%가 대리 예약이었고, 대리 예약에서 대상자 이름·생년월일을 잘못 전달해 현장에서 다시 접수한 사례가 많았다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: The brief names children in their 40s-50s, mostly employed, as the main proxy bookers.
evidence.quote: 부모 대신 예약하는 40~50대 자녀 | 대리 예약의 주 사용자. 직장인 비중이 높다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: On the commute one hand holds a strap; they enter from an alimtalk link and want to finish in five minutes.
evidence.quote: 출퇴근 버스·지하철 안: 자녀 사용자가 손잡이를 잡은 채 다른 손 하나로 부모 예약을 한다. 알림톡 링크로 들어와 5분 안에 끝내고 싶어 한다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: At lunch, siblings decide in a group chat who books, then book and share a screenshot of the result.
evidence.quote: 점심시간 사무실: 형제끼리 단톡방에서 "엄마 독감 주사 누가 예약해?"를 정한 뒤 바로 예약하고 결과 화면을 캡처해 공유한다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: On-site re-registrations caused by wrong target-person data in family proxy bookings run at about 300 a month; the first-season target is 30 or fewer.
evidence.quote: 가족 대리 예약 중 대상자 정보 오류로 인한 현장 재접수 | 월 300건 수준 | 월 30건 이하
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: Main phone brand, people in their 50s: Samsung 89% (Gallup, July 2025).
evidence.quote: 50대에서 삼성 사용 비중이 89%
evidence.quote_basis: search tool's extract of the page (may paraphrase; re-verify)

evidence.claim: Main phone brand, people in their 40s: Samsung 67%, so an iPhone minority exists in this segment.
evidence.quote: 40대도 67%로 삼성 선호가 우세
evidence.quote_basis: search tool's extract of the page (may paraphrase; re-verify)

evidence.claim: Free flu shots open by age band on different days (75+ first), which concentrates proxy bookings on each band's first day.
evidence.quote: 75세 이상 어르신의 경우 10월 15일부터 무료로 접종받을 수 있으며, 70~74세는 20일, 65~69세는 22일부터
evidence.quote_basis: search tool's extract of the page (may paraphrase; re-verify)

evidence.claim: Korean adults: deutan deficiency 2.5% of all participants, protan 0.4%.
evidence.quote: deutan deficiency (2.5%) had a higher prevalence than protan deficiency (0.4%)
evidence.quote_basis: search tool's extract of the page (may paraphrase; re-verify)

notes.age_bands: Placeholder: the brief gives 40~50대 without a split. Its worked example (박지훈, born 1978) is in his 40s.
notes.devices: Brand mix = mean of Gallup 2025 Samsung shares for the 40s (67%) and 50s (89%) = 78%; the rest is assigned to iPhone. Models within a brand are assumptions.
notes.familiarity: Inference, not measured: the service opened 2026-09-21 and flu booking opens 2026-09-28, so first-season bookers are new to it.
notes.presbyopia: Not declared: onset is in the 40s, but no Korean figure for this age mix was found; the tool's default (50s+ presbyopic) applies.

conditions.why: Korean adult population study: deutan 2.5% of all participants (any CVD: male 6.5%, female 1.1%). Slot availability (open/full) and status chips may rely on colour.

contexts.label_ko: 출퇴근 버스·지하철, 손잡이를 잡고 다른 손 하나로 조작

tasks.goal_ko: 등록 가족 어머니 박순자의 독감 무료접종을 본소 10월 15일(목) 오전 10:30으로 예약한다
tasks.jtbd: When free flu shots for people 75+ open and the health centre's phone line is jammed, I want to book my mother's shot from the alimtalk link in under five minutes, so she gets a first-day slot without me calling during work.

concrete_data.prescreen_answers: 발열 아니오 · 알레르기 아니오 · 이전 이상반응 아니오 · 최근 다른 접종 아니오 (예진 4문항; 답은 시나리오 선택)

tasks.success_ko: 예약번호가 표시되고, 박순자 · 독감 · 10월 15일(목) 오전 10:30 · 본소가 한 화면에 보이며, 신청자 번호로 안내 문자가 간다는 안내가 나온다 (형제에게 캡처해 보낼 수 있는 화면)

tasks.goal_ko: '내 예약'에서 어머니 독감 예약을 같은 날 오후 2:30으로 바꾸고, 못 가게 되면 취소한다
tasks.jtbd: When my mother's slot no longer fits my day, I want to move it to another time the same day or cancel it, so she is not a no-show and the slot goes to someone else.

concrete_data.fallback: 예약 취소 (취소한 자리는 바로 다른 신청자에게 열림)

tasks.success_ko: 내 예약에 박순자 · 독감 · 10월 15일(목) 오후 2:30 · 본소로 바뀌어 보이거나, 취소 완료가 표시된다

pain_points.text: Target-person selection may be error-prone: the brief reports about 300 on-site re-registrations a month from wrong names or birth dates in proxy bookings (phone channel). Check that the chosen family member's name and birth date are shown before submit.
The confirmation SMS goes to the applicant, not the parent, so the parent learns the time and place only if the child forwards it; the result screen has to work as a screenshot.
One hand holds a strap: the date/time picker and the submit button must be reachable with one thumb.

segments.name_ko: 자녀가 보내 준 링크로 직접 접종을 예약하는 65세 이상 어르신
segments.summary: Older adults eligible for free flu, COVID-19 and pneumococcal shots who book for themselves at home or in a senior centre from a link a child forwarded, and check the booking again in the health centre's waiting room on the day. Large budget Galaxy phones with enlarged system text, often used without reading glasses; many are first-time users who ask someone nearby or go back to the phone line when a step is unclear.

share.note: Only population bounds are known: 65+ are about 23% of 가람시's 380,000 residents (brief), 20.3% nationally (SRC-02), and 81.6% of them got the free flu shot last season (SRC-06). Their share of this product's users is unknown.

evidence.claim: The brief: 65+ are about 23% of 가람시; they use large budget Galaxy phones bought by their children, often with enlarged text and often without reading glasses.
evidence.quote: 가람시 인구 38만 명 중 약 23%. 독감·코로나19·폐렴구균 무료접종 대상. 자녀가 사 준 대화면 갤럭시 보급형을 많이 쓰고, 글자를 크게 설정해 둔 경우가 많다. 돋보기를 벗고 쓰는 일이 흔하다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: Many are first-time users at home or in a senior centre who ask someone nearby or go back to the phone when a step is unclear.
evidence.quote: 어르신의 집 거실·경로당: 자녀가 보내 준 링크로 직접 예약한다. 처음 써 보는 경우가 많고, 모르는 단계가 나오면 옆 사람에게 묻거나 전화로 돌아간다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.claim: About 1,900 wasted visits last season came from people who did not know their age band's start date.
evidence.quote: 시작일을 모르고 헛걸음하는 방문이 지난 절기 약 1,900건이었다.
evidence.quote_basis: document (read in full)

evidence.quote: 65세 이상 고령인구는 1,051만 4,000명으로 전체 인구의 20.3%
evidence.quote_basis: search tool's extract of the page (may paraphrase; re-verify)

evidence.claim: 81.6% of people aged 65+ (about 8.39 million) got the free flu shot in 2024-2025, so the booking task reaches most of this age group every season.

pain_points.text: Entry is a link in an SMS or KakaoTalk message while older users are warned not to open links in texts: expect hesitation or abandonment on the first screen unless the sender and address are recognisably the health centre's (hypothesis).
Age-staggered free-shot start dates caused about 1,900 wasted visits last season; the date picker has to say why a date is not available for the chosen person (hypothesis to check).
Enlarged system text and no reading glasses: small date/time chips, pre-screening radio buttons and the consent checkbox risk being unreadable or clipped (hypothesis).
App-only booking elsewhere was criticised for shutting older patients out.

segments.name_ko: 아침 식사 뒤 약을 먹고 그 자리에서 '복용 완료'를 누르는 고혈압·당뇨 등록관리 대상자
segments.summary: People in the health centre's hypertension/diabetes registry (about 12,000 in 가람시, ages 40-70s) who take pills one to three times a day, get a reminder, tap 'taken' at the breakfast table with a cup or pill box in the other hand, undo a mistaken tap, and look at weekly adherence and the latest blood pressure. share.note: Registry size only (about 12,000 in 가람시, brief). Their share of this product's users is unknown; they are the most frequent users (daily).

evidence.claim: About 12,000 registered hypertension/diabetes patients in 가람시 often skip or double doses; 'I can't remember whether I took this morning's pill' recurs in counselling.
evidence.quote: 보건소 고혈압·당뇨 등록관리 대상자(가람시 약 1만 2천 명)는 약을 빠뜨리거나 두 번 먹는 일이 잦다. 방문 상담 때 "오늘 아침 약을 먹었는지 기억이 안 난다"는 응답이 반복적으로 나온다.
